This Manual shows you how to stop re-explaining who you are and what you do in every new chat. It covers Claude only: it does not cover ChatGPT or other tools. It is a separate $27 charge, and your book order stays as it is.

It is a PDF with 19 chapters. Prices are in US dollars.
